name: jira-to-pr-workflow-mcp
description: MCP-native sibling of jira-to-pr-workflow: fetch a Jira ticket, gate it on quality, implement it, open a PR, and close the loop, all via connected Atlassian and GitHub MCP servers instead of a personal API token and the gh CLI.

GITHUB_PAT.title: GitHub personal access token
GITHUB_PAT.description: A fine-grained token, scoped to Pull requests: Read and write on whichever repo(s) this will run against. GitHub's MCP endpoint doesn't support OAuth, so this is required.
